 Siasat.com / Entertainment / Television News / Ugly physical fight in Bigg Boss 20, top contestant kicked out? Ugly physical fight in Bigg Boss 20, top contestant kicked out? 
 According to the latest updates from the show's live feed, a physical altercation broke out between contestants ScoutOP and Yung DSA during a captaincy task
 Rasti Amena Follow on Twitter |   Published: 10th November 2026 11:52 am IST Bigg Boss 20 contestants ScoutOP and Yung DSA (Instagram) Mumbai : Just like every season, Bigg Boss 20 has witnessed its fair share of controversies, heated arguments and ugly fights. While the season has already seen a few contestants cross the line, including Nakul Dhull, who was kicked out of the show following a physical altercation, another major fight has now grabbed attention. 
 According to the latest updates from the show’s live feed, a physical altercation broke out between contestants ScoutOP and Yung DSA during a captaincy task. The incident has sparked fresh controversy inside the house, with questions being raised over whether Scout will face eviction for getting physical with a fellow contestant.
 What happened between ScoutOP and Yung DSA?
 The incident reportedly took place during round 2 of the captaincy task, when Uditi was seated on the robot chair and Team A was assigned the task of making her cry.
 As part of the task, Scout attempted to trigger Uditi’s emotions by slightly burning the edge of her family photograph. However, Gullu and Yung repeatedly interrupted him while he was carrying out the task. Despite Scout warning them to stay away, Yung continued making comments, leading to a heated exchange between the two.
 The argument soon escalated, with both contestants reportedly exchanging abuses. Things took an ugly turn when Scout aggressively pushed Yung, making the situation physical.
 Yung reacted by declaring that their friendship was over, saying, “Ab dosti khatam.”
 https://twitter.com/itv_updates/status/2119804634546291039 Bigg Boss immediately intervened and separated the two contestants. Scout was instructed to stay inside the bedroom, while Yung was asked to remain in the garden area. The captaincy task was also put on hold following the incident.
 Yung DSA demands action against ScoutOP
 Following the altercation, Scout reportedly acknowledged that he had pushed Yung aggressively and approached him to apologise. Although Yung initially walked away without accepting the apology, the latest live-feed update suggests that he eventually accepted it and told Scout that it was okay.
 However, his decision did not go down well with fellow contestant Aamrapali Dubey. She questioned Yung for accepting the apology and urged him to take a firm stand against physical violence inside the house.
 Aamrapali reportedly told him that he should demand strict action from Bigg Boss against Scout or consider walking out of the show himself.
 Yung, too, is reportedly not ready to let the matter go easily. In another development, he allegedly told Bigg Boss that either Scout should be sent out of the house or he would be willing to leave the show himself.
 He also questioned why contestants who fail to respect the rules and boundaries of the house should be allowed to continue playing. Aamrapali has reportedly stood firmly by Yung and supported his demand for action.
 Bigg Boss announces 4 major punishments for ScoutOP
 While Scout’s eviction has been a major talking point among viewers, the latest updates suggest that Bigg Boss has taken strict action against him following the physical altercation.
 According to reports circulating about the live feed, Bigg Boss has announced four major punishments for ScoutOP:
 Nominated for the entire season: Scout will reportedly remain nominated for every upcoming eviction.
 No more captaincy: He will no longer be eligible to become the captain of the house.
 No special powers: He will reportedly lose access to any special powers going forward.
 Can be evicted anytime: Bigg Boss will reportedly have the authority to evict him at any point during the season.
 These punishments could significantly affect Scout’s journey in the competition, especially with the finale getting closer.
 The incident has once again raised questions about physical violence and the consequences contestants should face for crossing boundaries inside the Bigg Boss house.
 What do you think? Has Bigg Boss taken enough action against ScoutOP, or should he have been directly eliminated from the show?
